LOOK: The MMDA and DPWH will build underground water detention tanks—similar to the one in Burgos Circle, BGC—to help ease flooding in Metro Manila.

Construction at Camp Aguinaldo in Quezon City is set to begin this year. Other target sites include Liwasang Bonifacio, Rajah Sulayman, Remedios Circle, and UST. @News5PH
